tenant_memberships_deactivation_consiste.name: tenant_memberships_deactivation_consistent
tenant_memberships_deactivation_consiste.value: ("tenant_memberships"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "tenant_memberships"."deactivated_at" IS NULL) OR ("tenant_memberships"."status" = 'DEACTIVATED' AND "tenant_memberships"."deactivated_at" IS NOT NULL)

customers_deletion_dates_required.name: customers_deletion_dates_required
customers_deletion_dates_required.value: "customers"."deletion_status" = 'NONE' OR ("customers"."deletion_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."deletion_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."deletion_due_at" >= "customers"."deletion_requested_at")

customers_anonymization_recorded.name: customers_anonymization_recorded
customers_anonymization_recorded.value: "customers"."deletion_status" <> 'EXECUTED' OR ("customers"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."phone" IS NULL)

availability_calendars_scope_target.name: availability_calendars_scope_target
availability_calendars_scope_target.value: ("availability_calendars"."scope" = 'TENANT' AND "availability_calendars"."resource_id" IS NULL) OR ("availability_calendars"."scope" = 'RESOURCE' AND "availability_calendars"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL)

booking_policies_scope_target.name: booking_policies_scope_target
booking_policies_scope_target.value: ("booking_policies"."scope" = 'TENANT' AND "booking_policies"."service_id" IS NULL AND "booking_policies"."resource_id" IS NULL) OR ("booking_policies"."scope" = 'SERVICE' AND "booking_policies"."service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_policies"."resource_id" IS NULL) OR ("booking_policies"."scope" = 'RESOURCE' AND "booking_policies"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_policies"."service_id" IS NULL)

booking_policies_tenant_only_fields.name: booking_policies_tenant_only_fields
booking_policies_tenant_only_fields.value: "booking_policies"."scope" = 'TENANT' OR ("booking_policies"."booking_lead" IS NULL AND "booking_policies"."future_booking_limit" IS NULL)

booking_policies_nonnegative_values.name: booking_policies_nonnegative_values
booking_policies_nonnegative_values.value: ("booking_policies"."notice" IS NULL OR "booking_policies"."notice" >= 0) AND ("booking_policies"."booking_lead" IS NULL OR "booking_policies"."booking_lead" >= 0) AND ("booking_policies"."reminder_lead" IS NULL OR "booking_policies"."reminder_lead" >= 0) AND ("booking_policies"."reschedule_limit" IS NULL OR "booking_policies"."reschedule_limit" >= 0) AND ("booking_policies"."future_booking_limit" IS NULL OR "booking_policies"."future_booking_limit" > 0) AND ("booking_policies"."deposit_value" IS NULL OR "booking_policies"."deposit_value" >= 0)

booking_policies_percentage_range.name: booking_policies_percentage_range
booking_policies_percentage_range.value: "booking_policies"."deposit_mode" IS DISTINCT FROM 'PERCENTAGE' OR "booking_policies"."deposit_value" IS NULL OR "booking_policies"."deposit_value" <= 100

booking_events_member_actor.name: booking_events_member_actor
booking_events_member_actor.value: ("booking_events"."actor_kind" = 'MEMBER' AND "booking_events"."actor_membership_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("booking_events"."actor_kind" <> 'MEMBER' AND "booking_events"."actor_membership_id" IS NULL)

slot_claims_closure_consistent.name: slot_claims_closure_consistent
slot_claims_closure_consistent.value: ("slot_claims"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "slot_claims"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "slot_claims"."close_reason" IS NULL) OR ("slot_claims"."status" = 'CLOSED' AND "slot_claims"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
